Subject: Recap & next steps from today's call (Redwood pilot)

Hi Jamie / Priya —

Thanks for the time today — quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum:

Summary from call:
- Goal: 6-week pilot to validate latency/cost at typical query volumes for Search feature.
- Target metrics: 95th pctl latency < 350ms, token cost target <$0.0008/token (approx).
- Data: no PHI; standard product data and user queries.

Procurement / commercial items we covered and actions I have from the call:
1) Billing preference: Jamie mentioned preference to use PO for pilot if possible (finance), but card OK for smaller POs. Can you confirm which path you prefer for the pilot?
2) Marketplace: Priya asked about AWS Marketplace billing — we can support it; if that helps procurement we can enable that.
3) Budget / approvals: please confirm economic buyer and finance sponsor so we loop the right folks.
4) Docs: I'll send a short SOW, a commercial one-pager, and an example PO template for your procurement team.

Attachments I'll follow up with (in next email): Redwood SOW template, sample PO, procurement questionnaire.

Proposed next steps:
- I will share SOW + PO example by EOD tomorrow.
- Could we do a 30-min intro with your procurement + finance team next week to walk the process? I can include Vivek (contracts) and Stephanie (billing) from our side.

If you can reply with: preferred billing path (PO vs card vs marketplace), economics owner (who signs), and approximate internal approval timeline, that would help me prepare the right docs.

Thanks — looking forward to continuing.

Best,
Marissa Cole

Thanks Marissa — good recap. Quick answers from our side:

- Billing path: For pilots under $25k we usually accept credit card or a short-term PO. For anything above that procurement prefers a PO. For the 6-week pilot, likely a PO but we'll confirm based on final price.
- Marketplace: Yes — ACME prefers Marketplace purchases where possible (easier approvals and tagging). If you can offer an AMI/Marketplace listing or a SaaS listing, that's ideal.
- Budget owner / signatory: Economic buyer is Priya Singh (cc'd). Primary finance sponsor is Miguel Torres in Finance (miguel.torres@acme.com) — he handles vendor PO approvals. Final signatory for commitments is our CFO, Daniel Reeves.
- Timeline: Internal approvals typically 2–3 weeks once Procurement has the SOW/price.

Procurement contact for docs and PO routing: procurement@acme.com

Can you send the SOW + a sample PO and a short price breakout (line items)? We'll loop Miguel and procurement once we have those.

—Jamie
Jamie Clark
Senior Product Manager, Search | Acme Corp

Thanks Marissa — received the attachments and starting internal review. A few clarifications we need before looping procurement formally:

1) Pricing breakdown: can you provide unitized line items (setup fee, monthly pilot fee, per-token estimate)? Miguel will need that for budget center allocation.
2) Contract term: any minimum commitment after pilot? We prefer month-to-month after pilot or a short-term conversion option.
3) Marketplace billing: If we go Marketplace, will the pricing above be identical or will there be listing fees / margin adjustments?

Timeline: We expect to route to procurement next week if we have the line-item pricing. Our internal approval window for pilots of this size is about 2–3 weeks.
